definition_of_inert: a control is called INERT when its identity rate (installed sequence == baseline template) is ABOVE about 0.5, i.e. it reproduces the baseline ordering in the majority of rows and so cannot exhibit a difference either way
distance_only_identity_metric: per_mode.recon_only.identity_rate; `discard` is reported alongside because it must be behaviourally identical to recon_only (it pays the same decoder call)
interval_status: every interval here is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, carries no alpha, and is not confirmatory
ci_includes_zero_reading: a CI including zero means THE DIFFERENCE IS NOT ESTABLISHED; it is not evidence of no difference
program_main_gate_restated: the pickup MAIN gate requires >= 20 utility/day versus cond_hist with a paired CI lower bound > 0, plus a positive mean versus the same-initial-value reconstruction-only control. This sweep has NO cond_hist arm and few engineered states, so it CANNOT address the main gate.
